# R6.37 — Observation plumbing: durable model-view renderings of armed exec observations

Manifest ticket `295_R6.37__observation-plumbing.md` · branch `codex/harnessharness-r6.37` · base `origin/main` · engineered (offline, USD $0.00) · mergePolicy: OPERATOR.

## What this lands

G18 (spec §7.3): the live armed-exec observation path now renders the capability's declared `ResultRenderSpec.renderer` (R6.36's `json_head_tail@1`/`text_head_tail@1`, the one pure home `hharness_compiler::result_render`) over the kernel's observation record `{output, returncode?, exception_info?}`; the rendered string lands as a durable `text/plain` blob and `context.observation.recorded` carries `model_view{ref, renderer}` in the same fenced batch as `observed`/`completed` — durable before the request that carries it (X-04). The transcript re-serves the recorded bytes verbatim as the `tool` message content — never a re-render, never a re-derivation (unresolvable ref ⇒ `MalformedHistory`, the `response_ref` rule). No new event class (CC10); `model_view`/`admission`/`label`/`leaves` are absent-not-null (CC8). Unarmed sessions and renderer-less surfaces are byte-identical (`{"kind":"no_observation_recorded"}`).
